title: Blue Mountain Beach "Gulf Point Hideaway" 34 Gulf Point Road
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Gulf Point Hideaway" 34 Gulf Point Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool- Screened in porch fireplace- Convenient location- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover paradise at Gulf Point Hideaway! Sleeping up to 8 guests in charming Blue Mountain Beach, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers a delightful 30A escape for groups and families. Stroll to the white sand beach—only 4 minutes away—for a sun-kissed day playing in the Gulf, and on the journey home, head over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a sweet treat to top off the day. With a private pool, sprawling backyard, and screened-in porch boasting an outdoor fireplace, this exceptional home was made for enjoying every season on the coast!Warm hardwood floors and a serene neutral palette weave throughout this single-story property to create an inviting, restful setting. Upon entry, find a combined living, dining, and kitchen space that’s perfect for making memories together—whether it’s cozy evenings watching TV, slow-paced mornings preparing brunch, or gathering for meals around the 6-person table. The kitchen is beautifully equipped with high-end appliances and a spacious island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 4. Off the living space, discover the shaded veranda with soft patio seating and an overhead fan. The screened porch beside the kitchen features an alfresco dining table and a sitting area arranged around a fireplace—the ultimate spot to spend cooler coastal evenings. Continue outside to the backyard, where flourishing greenery provides lush privacy. Slip into the pool for a refreshing swim or unwind on the loungers. The sun shelf makes it easy to bask in the golden rays while staying cool or let little ones splash! After a trip to the beach, easily rinse off salt and sand at the outdoor shower. At bedtime, retire comfortably in the primary bedroom boasting a king bed and private bathroom, or the guest bedroom with a king bed. Kids can rest easy in the bunk room featuring 2 twin-over-twin bunks.Enjoy a walkable location, a private pool, and the blissful beauty of Blue Mountain Beach at Gulf Point Hideaway. On-site parking adds convenience, while the 3 complimentary adult bikes invite exploring via the Timpoochee Trail. To reach the beach, simply stroll down Gulf Point Road to the boardwalk. Book today for a carefree coastal escape!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
